audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. the relative entropy gives the wrong rate; control and action inconsistencies in the core proof; the sharp discrete dissipation bound loses a factor two
limitations: Counterevidence and alternatives: rho=1 has no mismatch.
Counterevidence and alternatives: The required rho weight already occurs in (10.24), supporting an intended local correction but not the literal printed definition.
Counterevidence and alternatives: The actual source page shows dx; replacing it by rho dx changes the definition.
Counterevidence and alternatives: Changing the equilibrium parameter or LDP speed is inconsistent with the displayed law and hypotheses.
Counterevidence and alternatives: The positive initial-profile witness rules out resolving the error solely by excluding vacuum.
Counterevidence and alternatives: Source p.47 already gives the correct plus-sign map; this is counterevidence against a new obstruction to the intended normalized theorem.
Counterevidence and alternatives: The theorem statement and (11.15)/(11.21) retain the compatible A/2 bracket coefficient.
Counterevidence and alternatives: Changing the definition of theta or the action would change the actual continuity constraint and cannot validate all literal displays simultaneously.
Counterevidence and alternatives: A positive constant correction of the appendix action dual preserves its qualitative lower-semicontinuity implication.
Counterevidence and alternatives: The source itself states the one-half Dirichlet-energy Gamma limit immediately before (5.42).
Counterevidence and alternatives: The periodic derivative jump is permitted by H1 and the lemma does not require a C-infinity spatial limit.
Counterevidence and alternatives: Changing the nearest-neighbour probability convention would also change the displayed one-half Laplacian generator limit.
Counterevidence and alternatives: A fixed positive factor does not change energy finiteness.
Counterevidence and alternatives: Using h-plus(s)=s log(s) changes the endpoint and is not the printed h.
Counterevidence and alternatives: The strictly subcritical upper bound in Lemma 4.4 is not contradicted.
Counterevidence and alternatives: rho=0 is deterministic vacuum, outside any universal positive-density divergence claim.
Counterevidence and alternatives: No permitted choice beta>alpha>1 makes a uniform linear mass bound possible.
Counterevidence and alternatives: On a fixed mass class, the corrected power can be absorbed in a mass-dependent constant.
Counterevidence and alternatives: The correction is already present at (5.16), but not in the literal lemma statement.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.

proposition.claim:
Equation reference: eq:printedH, eq:skeleton, eq:action, eq:continuousD. The torus has unit volume. Write \[h(s)=s\log s-s+1,\qquad h(0)=1.\] Source (3.6), p. 12, explicitly defines \[
\mathcal H_\rho(u)=\int_{\mathbb T^d}h(u/\rho)\,dx.\] The measure in that display is \(dx\), with no factor \(\rho(x)\). The definitions in source (1.6)–(1.8), p. 3, are \[
\partial_tu=\tfrac12\Delta u^\alpha-\nabla\cdot(u^{\alpha/2}g),
\qquad
\mathcal J(u)=\tfrac12\inf_g\|g\|_{L^2_{t,x}}^2,
\qquad
\mathcal I_\rho(u)=\alpha\mathcal H_\rho(u_0)+\mathcal J(u).\] The action in source (1.17)–(1.18), p. 5, is \[
\mathcal A(u)=\tfrac12\inf_\theta\|\theta\|_{L^2_{t,x}}^2,
\qquad
\partial_tu+\nabla\cdot(\tfrac12u^{\alpha/2}\theta)=0.\] The infima are over controls satisfying the displayed equations; these constraints cannot be changed when comparing their values. The dissipation in source (1.11), p. 4, is \[
\mathcal D_\alpha(u)=\frac2\alpha\int_{\mathbb T^d}|\nabla u^{\alpha/2}|^2\,dx.\]

Recorded check: the relative entropy gives the wrong rate

Unit-volume one-dimensional torus, alpha=2, t_fin=1, chi_N=N^-2 and the prescribed equilibrium product law. rho=1/2 for the two exact LDP events; rho=2 for the smooth entropy-action example. These are continuous strictly positive reference profiles; N^2*chi_N=1. All tested paths have finite energy; the second LDP witness has strictly positive initial density.

d=1, alpha=2, time interval [0,1]; all test paths are smooth and bounded below by 1. The action retains its printed one-half norm and one-half continuity flux. Projection is onto the closure of u*grad(phi).

repair.content:
Use Hhat_rho(u)=integral rho*h(u/rho) dx=integral[u log(u/rho)-u+rho] dx.

For w=Pi[u]grad(u^(alpha/2)), use g=theta/2+w, g^r=T w-T theta/2; use A/2 inside the J half-bracket and one-eighth quadratic penalty in the action dual.

Retain a half-weighted continuum dissipation in the sharp lower bound; the resulting bound implies F_alpha(u)<=2z.

Restrict the unconditional positive-density divergence assertion to gamma>alpha and state the endpoint dependence on rho and alpha.

Use 1+mass^beta, or explicitly restrict to a fixed mass cap with a constant depending on that cap.
